summary: Inventory is usually a file (INI, YAML) grouping hosts, with no SSL signing server; variables go in group_vars, host_vars or the inventory, and dynamic inventory can pull from EC2, OpenStack and others.
questions: What does a basic Ansible inventory file look like?
Where can I store variables for inventory groups?
Can Ansible pull its host list from AWS?

answer_card.title: Inventory overview
answer_card.answer_md:
```text
[webservers]
www1.example.com
www2.example.com

[dbservers]
db0.example.com
```
No SSL signing server needed. Assign variables in `group_vars/`, `host_vars/` or inline. Dynamic inventory can pull from EC2, Rackspace, OpenStack and more.
